I've updated the records: the Quarrendon Freight Lines 2026 renewal is now 100 seats. I replied to Ilse in a thread on their #north-random message to confirm.

- **The fix:** GBrain had saved the seat count from Ilse's #north-team post this morning as 261. I added a new fact with 100 seats that says it replaces that figure, citing Ilse's correction as the source. The 261-seat entry is still stored, though, because I added a fact rather than deleting the old one. If you want it gone so nothing can pick it up later, I can withdraw it.
- **What I left out of the reply:** I didn't repeat the old number in #north-random. June is in that channel but not in #north-team, so she couldn't have seen it.
- **Nothing else:** Ilse said no action was needed, so I didn't change anything else.
